protocol: Disc-fix posts proposed_change + evidence. Matrix runs phases and posts verdict pass|fail. Next patch only after pass. Simple English.

proposed_change.summary: Harden the shared CDVD complete path so every EE read does payload, then readee, then curReadPos, then complete_call. Optionally wake IOP sceCdSync waiters. No CNK Alchemy hacks. No WaitSema/SIF-end rewrite.
details: In kJobFsvRead / read_to_ee for normal LBAs: write sector payload to dst first.
Then fill eeaddr1 readee (_rd_intr_data): keep dest pointers, set length fields when feeding dest1, clear unused payload bytes.
Then write byte count to eeaddr2 (curReadPos) before sif::complete_call(0x80000595).
After complete, call a small shared wake so any IOP cdvdman sceCdSync waiters unpark (Hitman polls sceCdStatus/sceCdSync heavily).
Keep CNK virt-LBA / host_signal 16/54/55 / soft-arm / FCE0 / +24008 quarantined — do not use them here.
Do not change WaitSema/iSignalSema semantics (R2) or full SIF end rewrite (R1).
proposed_change.success_bar: Both games: primitives keep moving, ~60 FPS feel, graphics/settings menu untouched.

runs.cdvdfsv: N 0x1 + stream write after searches (SYSTEM.CNF, ERRORMES.ZIP, BOOTMENU.ZIP); DiskReady N 0xE then Read N 0x1
runs.iop_cdvdman: Heavy sceCdStatus + sceCdSync(mode=1) polling (~1.8k each in 600f) while EE reads use cdvdfsv
runs.shared_note: EE WaitSema leftover id 2; IOP thsemap WaitSema 1/2 spam around CD path

runs.cdvdfsv: Same N 0x1 → stream write → complete pattern; many sequential sector reads (boot + large 841-sector read)
runs.iop_cdvdman: Little/no sceCdSync spam; stalls show as EE WaitSema leftovers
runs.shared_note: EE WaitSema leftover id 2 shared with Hitman (libcdvd-class parking)

shared_signature.stall_class: CDVD complete / curReadPos / sync-wake contract — not Alchemy (no virt LBA, no GFC, no +24008, no host_signal 16/54/55)
shared_signature.prior_2k: triage-*-2k.log already showed Hitman ~586k prims / NFS ~1.15M prims at 2k frames with same leftover WaitSema pattern

gap_vs_sony: Need strict order: payload + readee + curReadPos BEFORE complete_call on every EE read
readee length fields should be set when dest1 is fed so AlignReadBuffer can run
Hitman also needs IOP sceCdSync waiters woken when FSV completes (cdvd.cpp finish_read-style wake)

matrix.notes: FAIL gate for proposed R3_generic_complete_path. Prove-before-swap: R1_SIF_end and R2_WaitSema_fidelity are still locked, so R3 must not land yet. Proposal also bundles R4-style sceCdSync waiter wake with R3 — that is a second order skip. Evidence itself is real (both games draw; Hitman BOOTMENU + ~1.8k sceCdSync/Status polls; NFS stream writes; shared leftover WaitSema 2; no Alchemy pulses). Independent matrix smokes logs/matrix-hitman-600.log and logs/matrix-nfs-600.log: Hitman 600f/78k prims/19 searches; NFS 600f/50k prims/67 streams; both frame-limit; SIF drains to 0; leftover semas match. Sony gaps still unproven in logs (no curReadPos/readee write lines). Huge garbage N-cmd counts seen (Hitman and NFS). Do NOT apply cdvdfsv/cdvd patch. Next: post R1 SIF-end proposal (or clear R1 with evidence) before any R3/R4 rewrite. No commit.

commit_policy: No commits until stable build; then commit freely.

waitsema_ownership.sema_2: Durable libcdvd-class parking (init=0,max=255, create once, never deleted). Hitman create_ra 0x001038CC / NFS 0x00495EA8 — ID coincidence, not temp RPC. Do NOT host_signal(2).
